title: Small Animal Friends
hook: Home-pet words, come sing with me!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: cute 3D small-animal storybook, cozy pastel habitats, soft rounded animals, clear isolated forms

creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: two-line memory anchor whose orchestration changes on repeat
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 alternates animal clues with care-item functions; care language stays gentle and never turns grooming or veterinary tools into child instructions.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 confirms with pointing, gentle animal motions or a care-item job gesture; no clipping, medicating, heating or tool use.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: soft marimba or bell-paw answer with no barking over diction.
